trans.sense: construction designed to solve a problem temporarily

raw_glosses: (informal, electronics, engineering) An improvised device, typically crudely constructed to test the validity of a principle before implementing a finished design.

raw_glosses: (informal) Any construction or practice, typically crude yet effective, designed to solve a problem temporarily or expediently.
